title: Week 7 · Density, ladders and hills
notes: Functional Bodybuilding week 7: no new export since 8 Nov, so anchors move one conservative step from the last logged sets (bench 8, split squat 8 each side; chin-up, row and RDL held at last week's targets, which still sit above the logged numbers). Accessories set C. New formats: Mon density block (AMRAP 8:00), Thu carry ladder, Sat kettlebell circuit, so no EMOM this week. Effort-led Tempo Triple on Tue (best on a track or the Assault Runner; hills by effort), gentle hills on Sat, walking pickups on Sun. No appointments 23–29 Nov.

adductor-rock.u: On hands and knees, one leg out to the side, rock the hips back.
s: Hands on the bench, one leg out to the side.
Keep your back flat and head up.
Rock your hips back slowly until the inner thigh stretches.
Pause, then rock forward, breathing out.
adductor-rock.m: Rounding the back to go deeper.
adductor-rock.z: Never force the stretch; keep breathing and stay head-up.

step-up.u: Step onto a low bench, drive through the heel of the lead leg.
s: Stand facing a low, steady bench or step.
Place one whole foot on it.
Drive through that heel and stand tall.
Lower for 3 seconds, breathing out as you stand.
c: Keep the knee in line with the toes
step-up.z: Use a low, stable step; hold the rack if wobbly; never hold your breath.

hip-airplane.u: Balance on one leg and turn the hips open and closed.
s: Stand on one leg, one hand on the rack.
Hinge forward until your body is nearly level.
Slowly turn your hips open, then back to square.
Breathe out as you turn; stand up between sides.
hip-airplane.m: Rushing the turn or bending the back.
hip-airplane.z: Hold the rack the whole time; keep your head level with your hips, never below.

side-lying-abd.q: side lying hip abduction glute medius
side-lying-abd.u: Lift the top leg slowly to work the side of the hip.
s: Lie on your side, head resting on your arm.
Top leg straight, slightly behind your body.
Lift the leg slowly, toes pointing forward.
Breathe out as you lift, lower for 1 s.
side-lying-abd.m: Rolling the hips back to lift higher.
side-lying-abd.z: Stop if the hip pinches; breathe throughout.
